stepNotes.1: Scoped format as a 2-file registry module: formatter.ts holds 25 Info descriptors (gofmt:64 -> dfmt:426), index.ts owns the Format namespace with init/status as the only public surface.
stepNotes.2: Traced two execution-injection vectors: project-config command injection is blocked by restrictUntrustedConfig (config-impl.ts:192-200); filename injection is mitigated because Process.spawn takes an argv array (index.ts:124), so no shell is invoked.
stepNotes.3: Confirmed matching formatters run sequentially (index.ts:121 for-of) and verified the chain semantics by the xAB test at format.test.ts:209; flagged a latent String.replace $-special-pattern bug at index.ts:125.
stepNotes.4: Verified enabled() results are memoized per instance (index.ts:87-94) and which() caches for 5 min (which.ts:19-20), so the Filesystem.findUp and which probes fire at most once per session, not per save.
stepNotes.5: The mergeDeep array-replace workaround at index.ts:68-73 is fragile: it seeds command/extensions from built-ins so an extensions-only override is not silently dropped (guard at index.ts:75), but a future Info field would need the same seeding.
stepNotes.6: No empty catches / TODOs. Found real triplication: the 28-entry web extension list is byte-identical in prettier (formatter.ts:86-113) and biome (formatter.ts:152-179), and manifest-dependency detection is near-identical across prettier/oxfmt/pint.
stepNotes.7: format.test.ts covers the key contracts (sequential run, mergeDeep regression, kill-wait race) but has a coverage gap: no regression test asserts that restrictUntrustedConfig strips command/environment from untrusted project formatter config.
stepNotes.8: No Critical or High findings; findings/ is empty. Dispositions are 3x LOW (replace bug, duplicated extension list, triplicated dep detection) and 2x INFO (forced enabled=true, ignored stdio) - none meet the bar for a tracked finding file.
stepNotes.9: Read-only review, no source modified, so no verify_project run is cited for a change; behavioral claims were validated by mapping each test assertion back to the cited implementation lines. reverify.md skipped because no Critical items exist.
